data.long_meaning: The name Premchandra is made up of two Sanskrit words: 'Prem' which means love and 'Chandra' which means moon. So, Premchandra translates to 'Precious Moon'. It is a name that evokes feelings of love, devotion, and the divine. The name Premchandra carries the meaning “Precious Moon” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Premchandra usually hope their child will grow to embody precious moon and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Premchandra belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Precious Moon.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Premchandra total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
